label: Newegg Marketplace

discovery.auth: api_key (developer-level API key in `Authorization` + seller-level `SecretKey` header, `?sellerid=` in the URL; keys issued by the integration team after approval)
sdks: official SDK / client libraries listed on the developer portal (create-your-own-client-library guide)

rate_limits: per-seller per-minute buckets, datafeeds hourly + size caps; headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/ResetTime, X-RecordCount-*; 429

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by
auth: 1. Platform registers as a third-party developer (e-mail Datafeeds@newegg.com) → developer API key.
2. Each tenant (seller) gets its Secret Key from Seller Portal / integration team and gives it + seller id to the platform.
3. Every call: developer key in Authorization, seller Secret Key in SecretKey, sellerid in the query string.

endpoints.call: Item management: create / update item, inventory + price update (single) + batch datafeeds
Order management: get order information (US / B2B / CA), confirm order, ship order (tracking), cancel
RMA: submit / edit / process RMA, issue courtesy refund, RMA status
Reports: order list, settlement summary, RMA report, inventory / price snapshot, item ranking
Datafeeds: item creation, inventory/price update, order shipment notice (XML)

reference.limits: Per seller: per-function limits in one-minute windows (X-RateLimit-Limit / Remaining / ResetTime); datafeeds hourly with record-count limits (X-RecordCount-*); HTTP 429 'Too many request', datafeed error DF012. - Seller agreement + API access approval; third-party developer registration for platforms. - Never share the seller's original key pair (Newegg guidance).
mcp_sdk: SDK: official SDK / client libraries listed on the developer portal (create-your-own-client-library guide)

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Newegg Marketplace API key assigned by the Newegg integration team (or your third-party developer key); sent verbatim as the Authorization header.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The seller's Secret Key (assigned to you, or to your third-party developer on the seller's authorization); sent as the SecretKey header.

config_fields.name: seller_id
config_fields.help: Your Newegg seller ID (e.g. A006); sent as ?sellerid= on every call.

config_fields.name: country_code
config_fields.help: ISO 3-letter ship-to country your prices target, e.g. USA; used in PriceList.Price[].CountryCode by update_listing/end_listing.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency matching country_code, e.g. USD for USA (wrong combinations are rejected).

config_fields.name: warehouse_location
config_fields.help: ISO 3-letter country of the warehouse whose stock set_inventory writes, e.g. USA.

adapter.terms: Newegg.com (US) Marketplace API over JSON; Newegg Business (/b2b) and Newegg.ca (/can) use different item endpoints and are not covered by this adapter. Rate limits are per seller and per function (per minute).

me.note: Seller Status Check: {IsSuccess, SellerID, SellerName, Status (Active|Suspended|InActive|Terminated|Closed), Membership, WarehouseLocation...}.

update_listing.note: Update Item Price (Type 1 = Seller Part #): sets the LIVE selling price for the configured country/currency. `listing_id` is your Seller Part #. Only the price is applied: stock is set_inventory; title/description are item content (datafeeds). Returns the item's PriceList in raw.

end_listing.note: Update Item Price with Active 0 deactivates the item for the configured country (reversible with Active 1; while deactivated, price and inventory updates are disregarded).

set_inventory.note: Update Item Inventory (Type 1 = Seller Part #): sets AvailableQuantity in the configured warehouse country; `sku` is your Seller Part # (required). SBN (Shipped by Newegg) items cannot be updated.

list_orders.note: Get Order Information (GetOrderInfoRequest): `status` is the numeric order status (0 Unshipped, 1 Partially Shipped, 2 Shipped, 3 Invoiced, 4 Voided, 5 Payment Pending); since = OrderDateFrom in Pacific time, e.g. '2026-09-01 00:00:00'; PageSize max 100. 1000 requests/hour. Items (ItemInfoList) and ship-to address are in raw.

not_offered.create_listing: Item creation goes through datafeeds (Item Creation feed with subcategory properties, manufacturer, UPC/MPN) — an asynchronous file submission, not a single call with the vocabulary's fields.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Ship Order (PUT /ordermgmt/orderstatus/orders/{ordernumber}) requires per package ShipCarrier, ShipService and an ItemList of SellerPartNumber + ShippedQty; items and ship service are not vocabulary inputs.
